evidence.original_label: SEpA-c505 分辨率（公司 东方晶源）
evidence.excerpt: 公司 东方晶源 日立高新 应用材料 ¦ 设备型号 SEpA-c505 CG 6300 Verity 6i ¦ 分辨率 1.4nm 1.35nm 1.45nm ¦ 重复测量精度 <0.15nm or 1% <0.15nm or 1% <0.1nm or 1% ¦ 产能 60 WPH 66 WPH 63WPH ¦ 单点量测时间 1.5s 1.6s 1.5s ¦ 机台同一性 <0.1nm or 1% <0.1nm or 1% <0.15nm or 1%

notes: Imaging resolution of the issuer’s latest-generation CD-SEM, printed as a point value. Distinct from a detection limit: this is the resolving power of the electron-optical system. The same table gives 重复测量精度 <0.15nm or 1% and 机台同一性 <0.1nm or 1%, both compound specifications combining an absolute bound with a relative one, which the metric vocabulary cannot express and which are therefore not recorded. The issuer states the model has taken a volume order from 客户 G and meets the needs of ≥28nm logic and 3D NAND lines. Benchmarks are 1.35nm for Hitachi High-Tech CG 6300 and 1.45nm for Applied Materials Verity 6i, so the issuer sits between the two rather than ahead. Issuer benchmark table: the 东方晶源 column is the first value column and only it is recorded as evidence about the issuer; the competitor columns are not evidence about those competitors. The excerpt reproduces the page’s own consecutive text lines, joined with ¦ to mark each line break; the separator is editorial.
